caption:
He sold his own auto-rickshaw to afford a trip to the national championships. This year, he won India its first medal at the Commonwealth Games.

Jhandu Kumar was born on January 1, 1997, in Harnaut, Nalanda district, Bihar and was affected by polio from birth. The son of a vegetable vendor, he helped sell vegetables and later worked as an auto-rickshaw driver to support his family. In 2023, he sold his own vehicle to fund a trip to the national para powerlifting championships. He began competing in para athletics in 2017 before switching to powerlifting and at the Commonwealth Games 2026 in Glasgow, he won bronze in men's heavyweight para powerlifting - India's first medal of the Games.
